response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), d AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), e AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS dev_minus_country_avg FROM d), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (dev_minus_country_avg IS NULL), dev_minus_country_avg DESC) AS rk FROM e) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, dev_minus_country_avg FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY rk
